recipe.visualDefinition: A formal studio portrait of a man in a dark suit against a deep, textured burgundy-red background, featuring asymmetrical left-aligned typography and vintage record label branding elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned slightly off-center to the right to balance heavy text block on the left.
Warm skin tones and white shirt collar provide high-contrast focal points against the dark suit and red backdrop.
Typography follows a staggered, right-justified staircase effect to lead the eye toward the subject's face.
coreInvariants: Deep burgundy-red monochromatic background with subtle vignette.
Formal attire including a dark suit, white shirt, and dark tie.
Left-heavy typographic composition with varying font scales.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close up portrait, subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white shirt collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large display text on the top left, moves down through the tracklist, and settles on the subject's face and clasped hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep red space surrounding the subject, particularly in the upper corners.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-key lighting with high saturation in the red channel; skin tones are natural and warm.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and transitional serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky serifs with high stroke contrast.
Secondary text uses a cleaner, lighter weight transitional serif.
Tight letter spacing (tracking) in the main title.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Apostrophes are stylized as simple vertical or slightly curved wedges.
Horizontal bars in 'E' and 'L' are thick and uniform.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with a readable transitional serif for detail.
graphicDevices: Small bullet points separating list items
Rectangular gold-toned badge/seal in the upper right

preserve: Right-alignment of the left-side text block
High-contrast slab serif for the main title
avoid: Centered text for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and structure of the main title.
Appropriate for the secondary tracklist text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a middle-aged man with short brown hair, wearing a dark 1960s-style suit, white shirt, and dark tie. He is smiling slightly and his hands are clasped in front of him. The background is a solid, textured deep burgundy red with a subtle vignette. The subject is positioned on the right side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large block of right-aligned text in the upper left quadrant using a heavy slab serif font in pale yellow. Below it, add a list of song titles in a smaller white serif font, also right-aligned. Place a small gold rectangular seal graphic in the upper right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the text block right-aligned and positioned on the left?
Is the background a consistent deep burgundy?
Is the subject wearing a formal dark suit and white shirt?
Is the main title font a heavy slab serif?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Proprietary record label logos and trademarks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red background has a slight paper-like texture.
Check that the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the slab serif font has sufficient weight.
Confirm the clasped hands are visible at the bottom.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Deep Red Background + Asymmetrical Slab Serif Typography + Right-Aligned Text Block
